about: Machine-readable Master Template (Brain/Master Template.docx): every system family, its allowed lines in the template's exact wording, when each applies, ownership, tech hours and price-book items. Precedence: HarkPro/doctrine/rulings.md > this file > Brain/Quantity rules.txt > everything else. Job-specific sample data in the template (tags, valve sizes, sheet numbers, floors, firm names, job numbers) is replaced by {placeholders} per AGENTS.md rule 1; such lines list what was replaced in 'redacted'.

fields.required: true = print whenever the family is in the job and applies_when holds (house default; the documents need not name the line). false = print only when this job's documents call for it.
fields.alt_group: lines sharing an alt_group are alternatives: print at most one (the template's OR).
fields.variant: a sub-type of the family (pick the variant first, then its lines; lines with no variant apply to every variant).
fields.template_exact: false = wording comes from a ruling, not the Master Template (absent = exact template wording).
fields.redacted: what job data was replaced by placeholders in the template wording.
fields.trimmed: the template paragraph carries extra words around the line (a label, a header form); the line text is the exact words inside it.
fields.owners: AME | Unit Mfr. | Mfr. | Others | Mechanical Contractor | FA | n/a | null (note lines). AME is the MC's sub: controls items 'by MC' are AME's (rulings R2).
